005package org.wpilib.driverstation;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DriverStationJNI;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.HAL;
009
010/** Provides access to error and warning reporting functionality to the Driver Station. */
011public final class DriverStationErrors {
012  static {
013    HAL.initialize();
014  }
015
016  private DriverStationErrors() {}
017
018  /**
019   * Report error to Driver Station. Optionally appends Stack trace to error message.
020   *
021   * @param error The error to report.
022   * @param printTrace If true, append stack trace to error string
023   */
024  public static void reportError(String error, boolean printTrace) {
025    reportErrorImpl(true, 1, error, printTrace);
026  }
027
028  /**
029   * Report error to Driver Station. Appends provided stack trace to error message.
030   *
031   * @param error The error to report.
032   * @param stackTrace The stack trace to append
033   */
034  public static void reportError(String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
035    reportErrorImpl(true, 1, error, stackTrace);
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * Report warning to Driver Station. Optionally appends Stack trace to warning message.
040   *
041   * @param warning The warning to report.
042   * @param printTrace If true, append stack trace to warning string
043   */
044  public static void reportWarning(String warning, boolean printTrace) {
045    reportErrorImpl(false, 1, warning, printTrace);
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Report warning to Driver Station. Appends provided stack trace to warning message.
050   *
051   * @param warning The warning to report.
052   * @param stackTrace The stack trace to append
053   */
054  public static void reportWarning(String warning, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
055    reportErrorImpl(false, 1, warning, stackTrace);
056  }
057
058  private static void reportErrorImpl(boolean isError, int code, String error, boolean printTrace) {
059    reportErrorImpl(isError, code, error, printTrace, Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace(), 3);
060  }
061
062  private static void reportErrorImpl(
063      boolean isError, int code, String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
064    reportErrorImpl(isError, code, error, true, stackTrace, 0);
065  }
066
067  private static void reportErrorImpl(
068      boolean isError,
069      int code,
070      String error,
071      boolean printTrace,
072      StackTraceElement[] stackTrace,
073      int stackTraceFirst) {
074    String locString;
075    if (stackTrace.length >= stackTraceFirst + 1) {
076      locString = stackTrace[stackTraceFirst].toString();
077    } else {
078      locString = "";
079    }
080    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
081    if (printTrace) {
082      boolean haveLoc = false;
083      for (int i = stackTraceFirst; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
084        String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
085        traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
086        // get first user function
087        if (!haveLoc && !loc.startsWith("org.wpilib")) {
088          locString = loc;
089          haveLoc = true;
090        }
091      }
092    }
093    DriverStationJNI.sendError(isError, code, error, locString, traceString.toString(), true);
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Report crash to Driver Station. Appends provided stack trace to crash message.
098   *
099   * @param details The crash details to report.
100   * @param stackTrace The stack trace to append
101   */
102  public static void reportCrash(String details, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
103    reportCrashImpl(details, stackTrace, 0);
104  }
105
106  private static void reportCrashImpl(
107      String details, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace, int stackTraceFirst) {
108    String locString;
109    if (stackTrace.length >= stackTraceFirst + 1) {
110      locString = stackTrace[stackTraceFirst].toString();
111    } else {
112      locString = "";
113    }
114    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
115    boolean haveLoc = false;
116    for (int i = stackTraceFirst; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
117      String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
118      traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
119      // get first user function
120      if (!haveLoc && !loc.startsWith("org.wpilib")) {
121        locString = loc;
122        haveLoc = true;
123      }
124    }
125    DriverStationJNI.sendProgramCrash(details, locString, traceString.toString());
126    // Sleep to ensure message is sent before crash
127    try {
128      Thread.sleep(100);
129    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
130      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
131    }
132  }
133}
